nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$ there is an admissible set $H$ of exactly $k$ integers that is difference $k$-smooth: for all distinct $h, h' \in H$, every prime factor of $h - h'$ is at most $k$.
nodes.title: Admissible difference-smooth sets of every size

nodes.summary: There are infinitely many pairs of primes $p > q$ such that every prime factor of $p - q$ is at most $47$.
nodes.title: Infinitely many prime pairs with $47$-smooth difference

nodes.summary: If the Elliott–Halberstam conjecture holds, then there are infinitely many pairs of primes $p > q$ such that every prime factor of $p - q$ is at most $5$.
nodes.title: Prime pairs with $5$-smooth difference under Elliott–Halberstam

nodes.summary: Let $m \ge 2$ and $k$ be natural numbers such that every admissible finite set $H$ of at least $k$ integers has infinitely many integers $n$ for which $n + h$ is a (positive) prime for at least $m$ elements $h \in H$. Then there are infinitely many $m$-tuples of primes $p_1 < p_2 < \dots < p_m$ such that for all $j < i$ every prime factor of $p_i - p_j$ is at most $k$.
nodes.title: Prime $m$-tuples with smooth gaps

nodes.summary: For every natural number $y$ and every integer $a$, the set $\{a\}$ is difference $y$-smooth.
nodes.title: One-element sets are difference smooth

nodes.summary: Let $y$ be a natural number. A finite set $H$ of integers is difference $y$-smooth if for all distinct $h, h' \in H$ every prime factor of $h - h'$ is at most $y$.
nodes.title: Difference-smooth sets of integers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m \ge 2$ there is a natural number $k$ such that for every admissible finite set $H$ of at least $k$ integers there are infinitely many integers $n$ for which $n + h$ is a (positive) prime for at least $m$ elements $h \in H$.
nodes.title: Maynard–Tao theorem

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be an admissible finite set of $k \ge 2$ integers, let $z \le k$ be a prime and let $\ell < z$ be a natural number. Then $H$ is not difference $\ell$-smooth. Equivalently, $H$ is not difference $\ell$-smooth for any $\ell$ less than the largest prime at most $k$.
nodes.title: Admissible sets are not difference smooth at small bounds

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.

breadcrumbs.label: Prime gaps and primes in short intervals
